description: This file defines an abstract class for background synchronization scheduling and a concrete implementation that performs periodic sync while the app is in the foreground. It manages timing for sync operations using a Timer and interacts with a SyncEngine to trigger synchronization.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncScheduler
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for background sync schedulers.

classes.name: ForegroundResumedSyncScheduler
classes.description: Implementation of BackgroundSyncScheduler that runs periodic syncs while the app is foregrounded.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing timer to stop periodic sync.
